title: Activation Pathway: Empty-state widgets, microflows & in-context tips for Console
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Deliver a compact set of reusable empty-state widgets, microflow overlays, and in-context tips for the Console activation pathway. Focus is on first-time users who have no connected models, no pipelines, or no eval sets. Components must be modular (cards, micro-tips, persistent banner) so PM/Eng can enable/disable per-route. Ensure WAI-ARIA compliance, responsive variants, and tokenized visuals for theming. Include asset exports, high-fidelity screenshots for docs, and a small animation spec for the product tour step.
acceptance_criteria: 3 reusable empty-state card templates (model-connector, dataset-upload, create-eval) with copy variants for 'trial' and 'enterprise' tiers
Microflow overlay flow for first-run that can be triggered via query param and dismissed; 3 steps, accessible via keyboard and screen readers
In-context tip component (tooltip + mini CTA) that supports function-calling examples and links to docs
Figma file with all components, developer tokens, and an export-ready sprite sheet (SVG + PNG 2x)
Annotated screenshots and a short animation (MP4/WebM) for release notes and docs
Sign-off from PM (Maya Singh) and Eng lead (Ravi Patel) recorded in review comments
